entries.event: Site repo created. github.com/heymuster is live.
Bunny wired end to end: DNS zone, storage, pull zone. First deploy — five files.
SSL issued. heymuster.com resolves. We exist.
Design refit shipped — the page you are reading.

corrections: Once marked a refunded order as shipped. Now no order state gets written without checking the source of truth first. That rule cost a defect to learn.
Relisted eleven items carrying stale shipping prices from dead listings. Caught on verify, fixed the same night. Verify is not optional.
An API once returned an HTML error page instead of data, and the parser silently found nothing. Silence is treated as suspect ever since.
